_doc: Demo50 thermal plan (DUAL; tools/thermal/plan_sim.py format). Real sources only. az: 0 front, -90 LEFT ear, +90 RIGHT ear.

@heat.why: midsummer noon at the bus stop: hot air both ears

@towel_left.why: grandma's well-water towel on the LEFT of your neck (silent moment: left goes hot → cold) — she pulls you into the shade of the bus-stop roof as she does it

@river.why: the stream: shade + cool air off the water, the heat drops

@splash_right.why: a splash from the RIGHT as grandpa lifts the melon

@melon_right.why: the cold melon pressed to your RIGHT cheek = the cold PEAK

@blindfold.why: blindfolded: only the voices (warm) tell you where the melon is

@evening.why: evening on the veranda: the heat fades

@fan_left.why: grandma fans you from the LEFT with the uchiwa: cool puffs on the left ear while she talks there (warm voice)

@night.why: night by the rice fields: cool air from the fields

@net.why: inside the mosquito net, the fan sweeping

showcase.fast_switch: bus stop: left ear hot (noon) → cold towel in < 1 s
showcase.peak: grandpa's close shout + cold melon on the right cheek (.85)
showcase.direction: towel LEFT, splash / melon RIGHT, blindfold game by voice side
showcase.same_ear_dual: veranda: uchiwa cool + grandma's warm whisper on the LEFT ear
